Q: What common mistakes do I have to avoid in nursing assignments?

Many students lose marking for easily avoidable academic errors. The major list of areas to avoid are:

  • Lack of critical engagement- Covers descriptive writing but no analysis.
  • Over-dependence on poor- quality or obsolete sources.
  • Wrongly referenced or inconsistent citation format.
  • Not tracing theory into real practice situation.
  • Assignment briefs or learning outcomes were ignored.
  • Deficient structure or grammar errors.

Before submitting your assignment, ensure you use some https://www.blackfawnfilms.com/ proofreading tools and check your marking rubric.
